{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic v2 an Optional[X] annotation without a default is required. Adding `= None` restores the v1 behavior, where these fields defaulted to None. This also fixes the test failure: profile_from_form drops empty and None form values, so bio/website/age are absent from the kwargs, and without a default Profile raises 'Field required'. With the default, the omitted fields become None as the test expects. The typing imports are still used, so no import changes are needed."}], "notes": "All four findings share one root cause and are fixed by one edit to the three Optional fields. The test-failure finding (line 15) is resolved by the same change, because profile_from_form omits blank values and relies on the None default. I made no other changes. Documentation was not retrieved, so the explanation relies on the v2 rule that Optional[X] without a default is required. Not verified by running the test suite."}
